The balance sheet shows only modest liquidity (current ratio 1.18) and fairly high leverage (liabilities are about 65% of assets, with equity covering just over half of liabilities), while EBIT is positive but small relative to the asset base. Positive retained earnings and a solid operating margin help, but overall the profile looks more consistent with a speculative-grade issuer than an investment-grade one.

DECISION: BB-
